selection_reason: The 180k stage is the lightest allowed candidate and preserved the hunting-rifle silhouette, scope, stock, muzzle, grip contract and UV appearance.

source_high_density_preserved.note: Preserved without overwrite. Its reflected axis conversion left face winding inverted; all promoted candidates correct winding once before decimation.

visual_qa.views_per_stage: six orthographic axes plus two isometric views
visual_qa.pbr_uv_comparison: pass; forest-green stock, walnut inserts and metal surfaces remain continuous without visible UV tears
visual_qa.silhouette: pass; stock, stock wrist grip, trigger guard, magazine, receiver, scope, fore-end, thin barrel and muzzle device remain stable at 180k
visual_qa.muzzle: pass; opening remains legible and measured depth stays above 0.08m
visual_qa.backface: pass after one face-winding correction; green exterior in all eight views, magenta limited to legitimately visible interior/rear-facing surfaces
